summary.zh: 新增 agenthelm dedupe：处置 inventory 报告的重复分组。Skill 副本可保留一份并归档其余（可恢复，不删除）；MCP 副本只给官方手工命令，不编辑配置；全部保留与忽略只写机器级决定文件；另提供只读的 Claude Desktop 配置可粘贴片段。
summary.en: Add agenthelm dedupe: handle the duplicate groups inventory reports. Skill copies can be kept once with the rest archived (recoverable, never deleted); MCP copies get only the official manual command and no config is edited; keep-all and ignore write only a machine-level decision file; plus a read-only paste-ready Claude Desktop config snippet.
